fields.raw_value: 06 Residential Towers (T28, T29, T30, T31, T32, T33) part of overall 65 acre Mixed Use Development located on Bellary Road, Byatarayanapura, Bangalore, India and comprises of Commercial Offices, Multiplex, Residential, Clubhouse, etc., The intent is to create a masterpiece in residential living integrated with Offices which will be a lifestyle destination in achieving “Walk to Work” concept. Along with this the endeavour is to create a fully sufficient, sustainable, self-contained gated and secure township with local retail, public/semi-public amenities, parks & open spaces, strong urban streets, utilities etc. A place which will have unique themed gardens/landscapes with unique features like putting green as mini golf course practice, tennis courts, cycling/skating track, etc. Various infrastructure facilities like roads, power, water management system, reticulated gas supply system, waste management system (solid & sewage), high-tech optical fibre connectivity are expected to be seamlessly integrated into the Mixed Use Development. The theme is to create Gated Community Neighbourhood catering to the middle income & high income groups with integrated Work Place which will be path breaking or futuristic in development, reflecting L&T's values towards environment and sustainability. The development should be a destination which people would desire or yearn to belong to and should be proud to behold.
